data.text: May God be gracious to us and bless us; may he make his face shine upon us, Selah,
data.titulo: God's Blessing Made Known among the Nations
data.subtitulo: For the music director. With stringed instruments. A psalm. A song.

data.text: so that your way may be known on earth, your salvation among all nations.
Let the peoples praise you, God; let all the peoples praise you.
Let the nations rejoice and sing for joy, for you judge the peoples with equity and guide the nations on earth. Selah.
Let the peoples praise you, God; let all the peoples praise you.
The earth has yielded its harvest; God, our God, will bless us.
data.titulo: The Harvest and God's Continuing Blessing

data.text: God will bless us, and all the ends of the earth will fear him.
